_: `V90Modem::reset` -- the gated banner, printTitle, and a three-way
switch on `side` with one arm doing work.  t_v90modemctor's
run_reset builds a real V90Modem on both sides, sweeps side over
{0, 1, 2}, PROBING_MODE over five values and qcFlag over four, and
asserts the descriptor and the demodulator's own quickConnect.

label: probe mode reports itself and masks nothing
probe mode masks the descriptor but not the demodulator's flag
the mask is re-derived at the call rather than applied to the variable
why: The object masks the VARIABLE -- `xor %esi,%esi` at 0x19a6d, where %esi is `qcFlag` -- and this spelling recomputes the same mask at the one remaining reader.  Nothing between the two sites writes PROBING_MODE, so the two programs agree on every input; it is here because it is the near-miss of the mutation above, and separating a defect from a rewrite is the point of recording it as equivalent rather than as a gap.
